bean.description: Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.createOrGetCommerceCase() — the PCP commerce case + checkout identifiers for the current cart.
Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.createAuthenticationToken() — the merchant JWT for the hosted card iframe.
Frontend-supplied request for PayoneCheckoutFacade.executePaymentAndPlaceOrder() — CARD or SEPA.
Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.executePaymentAndPlaceOrder() — the placed order (if successful) and the mapped payment status.
Frontend-supplied payment details for PayoneCheckoutFacade.authorizePayment() — dispatch is by the explicit paymentProductId parameter, not a paymentMethod string.

property.name: bic
customerIpAddress
property.description: PaymentMethodSpecificInput.customerDevice.ipAddress - mandatory for every PAYONE BNPL (FINANCING) payment; not read for other families today.

property.name: googlePayEncryptedPaymentData
property.description: MobilePaymentMethodSpecificInput.encryptedPaymentData - Google Pay's one-time payment token; not read for other families today. Not yet wired into DefaultPayoneCheckoutFacade (see PayonePaymentInfoModel.googlePayEncryptedPaymentData - Google Pay needs One-Step checkout, which the Step-by-Step authorizePayment path does not support yet).

property.name: applePayEncryptedPaymentData
property.description: MobilePaymentMethodSpecificInput.encryptedPaymentData for Apple Pay - minimal cut, not the full PKPaymentToken shape. Not yet wired into DefaultPayoneCheckoutFacade (same One-Step gap as Google Pay).

bean.description: Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.authorizePayment() / handleRedirectCallback() — tells the frontend "redirect now", "payment done", or "wait".
Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.placeOrder() (strategy-routed path) — the PCP identifiers and mapped status for the placed order.

Result of PayoneCheckoutFacade.capturePayment()/cancelPayment()/ refundPayment() — the mapped status after a post-authorization payment-execution operation. Never a redirect (only Create can redirect), so this stays smaller than PayoneAuthorizationResultData rather than reusing it.
